Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Wood and Antique Mirror Panel Bedside Nightstand, Brass Finish, 24", Brown
Colors: Brown
Materials: wood
Bring a minimalist chic look to your bedside with this simple nightstand. The antique mirror panel fronts add visual detailing, while brass finish accents the bold, sturdy base. Two drawers provide storage and style. 24"W x 17"D x 24"H; LegHeight: 8" Two storage drawers No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
